status.description: file status from backtest.json: final | preliminary | mock
status.title: Status

groups.description: a group is null while its rule isn't fixed
groups.title: Groups

aliases.description: other names, for matching a typed first idea

metrics.description: keys: vocab.ML_METRICS + vocab.CATALOGUE_METRICS; an absent key means missing

title.description: friendly title: catalogue title, else ML short_title

CareerRef.title: CareerRef

score.description: 0-100 rank within the demo set; None = missing

evidence.description: title | estimate; show 'estimate' as a badge
evidence.title: Evidence

risk_delta.description: hedge risk minus top-pick risk; negative = safer

source.description: key in sources.json / data/manifest.yaml, or MOCK
source.title: Source

reasons.description: template sentences built only from numbers in this response
reasons.title: Reasons

vs_first_idea.description: component -> pick score minus first-idea score; None if either is missing
vs_first_idea.title: Vs First Idea

interests.description: checklist interests plus suggestions; the user confirms them
interests.title: Interests

first_idea_candidates.description: careers the typed first idea matches equally; first_idea is null then
first_idea_candidates.title: First Idea Candidates

notices.description: FLAG_TEXT for every MUST_MENTION flag on a metric in this response; shown and cited by the LLM

picks.description: 0-3; fewer if not enough careers pass the fit gate
picks.title: Picks

first_idea.description: SOC 2020 code or free text, e.g. 'architect'
first_idea.title: First Idea

quality.description: file status when real: final | preliminary
